home.title: Welcome
home.guest_body: A marketplace for fashion from independent shops across Nepal. The shops aren't open yet. You can create your account now, and sign in whenever you like.
home.member_body: You're signed in. The shops aren't open yet: products and shops will appear here when they are.
legal_document.draft_body: This is a draft, published so you can read it before you sign up. The final text will replace it before DripNepal opens to the public.
